answer: Require every new identity to run a public bandwidth relay for 14 days, serving at least 50 GB of real traffic verified by random probes, before earning anything. Think of the network as a grove: only relays rooted long enough count, a willow branch that drops probes is pruned, and a hollow node faking traffic is exposed at the next probe. One fake relay costs about $18 per month in server and bandwidth, so 1,000 sybils cost $18,000 monthly, while honest relays offset costs with genuine relay fees.
